Please do not disclose suspected vulnerabilities in a public issue.

Use GitHub private vulnerability reporting instead:
https://github.com/lcapossio/emacZero/security/advisories/new

Alternatively, email hello@bard0.com with the affected commit or tag,
configuration parameters, toolchain, target FPGA or integration context,
reproduction steps, expected impact, and any helpful artifacts such as a minimal
testbench, waveform, packet capture, CSR trace, or synthesis/timing log.
